description: This header file declares the API functions for interacting with the OVS Agent, including initialization, deinitialization, configuration retrieval, and database interaction. It defines function prototypes, includes necessary headers, and uses include guards to prevent multiple inclusions.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_init
methods.description: Initializes the OVS Agent API, allocating internal data structures and setting up the OVS DB socket.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_deinit
methods.description: De-initializes the API, freeing resources and internal data.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves and initializes configuration data for a specified table to default values.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_interact
methods.description: Submits a request to interact with the OVS database abstraction layer, with a callback for response handling.
